prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / identity-preserve.
Asset type: single medieval RPG dialogue HEAD portrait, intended for export to 74 x 100 pixels.
Input 1 is the selected character identity reference ONLY. Inputs 2–5 are coarse pixel portrait STYLE references, never their identities or worried V eyebrows. Substantively redraw the character, do not crop the old full-body image.
Composition: portrait 74:100 aspect. Very tight large adult head, all hair/headscarf and both ear silhouettes remain inside the canvas with narrow transparent safe margins. Head extends roughly 3% to 89% of canvas height. BIG face, very short almost hidden neck, clothing is only a tiny narrow collar strip at bottom 7–10%; no broad shoulders or chest. Mild three-quarter angle toward viewer left, nose side and cheekbone readable. Preserve safe hair/headwear silhouette margins rather than clipping to fill.
Style: chunky hard-edged low-resolution pixel clusters, broad connected cheekbone, nose bridge, nostril, jaw and eye-socket planes; simple deliberate step contours and substantial shadow masses. Earthy palette designed for a temporary maximum 32 work colors. Skin 4–6 large tones, restrained highlights. Dark compact naturally sized eyes, small low-contrast whites. Hair in 3–5 large connected masses, no tiny strands. No gradients, soft antialiasing, dithering, thin random streaks, photographic texture, glossy dots or fine isolated pixels. Distinct adult facial anatomy and age, no anime/chibi same-face.
Genuinely transparent background. One head, no props, lettering, border, landscape, hands, limbs or effects. This is a freshly generated drawing followed by explicitly disclosed nearest-neighbor and palette quantization derivative export, not native pixel authorship.
Character: RISHA / 芮莎 / BRY-S02-NPC, a FEMALE town grain keeper around FIFTY years old. Preserve the selected identity: muted dark brick-red tied headscarf with a compact knot/tail, dark brown hair under scarf in broad practical side locks, olive work clothing and coarse pale cream apron edge. The current card's age overrides the old cute full-body treatment: visibly fifty, broad robust cheek planes, slightly heavy lower cheeks, strong blunt rounded nose, sturdy jaw and restrained age lines at lower eye/outer cheek. Warm weathered skin. Not a young woman, not a frail old crone.
Expression: matter-of-fact steady appraisal, faintly narrowed attentive sideways eyes, mostly level relaxed brows, closed straight mouth with one subtly firm corner. She measures before she speaks; she protects next season's seed and can acknowledge a bad promise. No generic distressed brow, angry scowl, miser caricature, smile or pleading.
Only a tiny olive neckline and pale apron strap/bib edge at bottom. Short neck. Red headscarf must leave brow, ears and cheek completely legible. Keep knot fully contained and compact. No bag, ledger, scales, grain, money, contract or hands in crop. Do not depict repayment, forgiveness or a resolved sale.
